The unified browser UI is the recommended daily entry point; ChatGPT, Gemini and othe"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"r external MCP clients remain supported. It exposes a dedicated workspace with shell, persistent she"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ll, filesystem, search, patch, Playwright, audit, durable logical sessions with optional Goal plans,"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" public file links, and outbound remote-worker access. Git is handled through ordinary shell command"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"s instead of a parallel wrapper API."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The intended safety boundary is the container or VM, not the host."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why use it"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Capability | What it enables |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Real terminal access | Run tests, build projects, inspect logs, and debug with persistent shell se"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ssions. |
| Workspace-aware file tools | Read, write, patch, search, and review files under a contro"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"lled root. |
| Git workflow support | Run the standard Git CLI through shell tools without a second,"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" incomplete Git abstraction. |
| Browser automation | Extract page text, capture PNG/PDF evidence, o"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"r run a full Playwright script. |
| Native desktop GUI | Observe accessibility trees plus screenshot"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"s and control Linux, Windows, or macOS applications with guarded semantic/coordinate actions. |
| Re"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"mote workers | Control NAT, firewall, HPC, NPU, or lab machines that can only connect outward. |
| A"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"gent Skills | Discover, load, and read reusable `SKILL.md` workflows through three fixed tools witho"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ut changing the MCP tool list. |
| Unified web workspace | Chat, projects, history, files, terminals"},{"id":"p10s10","text":", desktop, sessions, remotes, audit and nested MCP management in one browser UI. |
| External MCP cl"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"ients | OAuth 2.1 and `/mcp` for ChatGPT, Gemini and other compatible clients. |
| DeepSeek Harness "},{"id":"p10s12","text":"plugin | Install this repository as a DSH bundle and expose the complete LSM tool surface, including"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" remote workers. |
| ChatGPT Live Workspace | Render a native MCP App for real-time activity, termin"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"al, files, diffs, jobs, remotes, audit, and direct human/agent collaboration inside ChatGPT. |
| Saf"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"er operations | Workspace scoping, shell timeouts, output limits, environment filtering, audit logs,"},{"id":"p10s16","text":" and secret scanning. |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Recommended deployment: the standalone single-file Controller executable** from GitHub Releases. I"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"t bundles the Controller and native WebUI, runs without a system Python installation or Docker, and "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"needs no repository checkout. Choose the matching binary for your OS/architecture; the following exa"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"mple is for **Linux x86_64**:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Create a private `.env` file with the necessary `LOCAL_SHELL_MCP_` variables (see the quickstart). For remo"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"te access, prefer a public HTTPS server or reverse proxy; Cloudflare Tunnel is not recommended for f"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ile-heavy transfers. Keep OAuth enabled on publicly accessible endpoints."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The one-file executable is the **Controller distribution**, not an all-inclusive operating-system im"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"age. It uses host-installed task tools and optional external Playwright/browser dependencies. Integr"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ated **chat and projects** use the separately deployed unified web workspace (Node.js, MongoDB, Meil"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"isearch, and SearXNG); the remote **Worker** is distributed separately. No chat backend or database "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"is claimed to be embedded in the Controller binary."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Other deployment methods remain supported: Docker Compose, Python/pipx/source, and the VS Code exten"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"sion. See platform-specific binary installation for Windows, macOS, ARM64 and updates."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Human interface"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The **recommended interface** is the unified web workspace, which integrates chat and LSM Controller"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" pages directly into a modified LibreChat React application. It uses the LSM login, stores chat proj"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ects and history on the server, and manages external tools through LSM's nested MCP registry. Its No"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"de.js, MongoDB, Meilisearch and SearXNG services are **optional**, deployed separately from the ligh"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"tweight Controller and Worker bundles."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"This project intentionally exposes powerful tools. Treat the connected model as having control of th"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"tionally exposes powerful tools. Treat the connected model as having control of the container or VM."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Default protections include:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Workspace scoping to `/workspace` unless full-container mode is explicitly enabled.
- Command time"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"outs, output limits, and concurrency limits.
- Default command/path denylists for host-control fragm"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ents.
- Shell preflight is a best-effort efficiency guard for common recursive discovery forms (for "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"example `Get-ChildItem -Recurse`, `find`, `rg`, and `grep -R`): it blocks recognized wide unbounded "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"scans, bounds narrower expensive discovery, and redirects agents toward scoped file tools. It is not"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" a shell security boundary.
- Shell subprocess environment filtering for service-side secrets.
- Dyn"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"amic stdio MCP servers inherit only a minimal OS environment plus explicitly configured per-server v"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"ariables; configured environment/header values are stored in a mode-`0600` state file and redacted f"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"rom tool results and Audit arguments.
- Audit logs at `/workspace/.local-shell-mcp/audit.jsonl`.
- S"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"ecret scanning helpers before commits and pushes.
- Tokenized file links with TTL/download limits an"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"g helpers before commits and pushes.
- Tokenized file links with TTL/download limits and revocation."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Hard rules:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"1. Do not mount `/var/run/docker.sock`.
2. Do not mount the host root filesystem.
3. Do not expose t"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"he service with `LOCAL_SHELL_MCP_AUTH_MODE=none` on a public network.
4. Do not put long-lived crede"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ntials in environment variables visible to the model.
5. Prefer single-repository deploy keys or sho"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"rt-lived tokens.
6. Run the service in a disposable container or VM.
7. Treat the `local-shell-mcp-c"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"redentials` Docker volume as sensitive."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"For vulnerability reporting, read SECURITY.md."}],"truncated":true}
